title: Mayon erupts, sends 3-km ash plume above crater
text: Mayon erupts, sends 3-km ash plume above crater MANILA, Philippines — Mayon Volcano had a moderately explosive eruption on Friday, sending an ash plume 3 kilometers above its crater, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology (Phivolcs). MANILA, Philippines — Mayon Volcano had a moderately explosive eruption on Friday, sending an ash plume 3 kilometers above its crater, according to the Philippine Institute of Volcanology and Seismology . The eruption started at 11:53 a.m. and ended at 11:59 a.m., with the grayish ash plume drifting west-southwest. Mayon Volcano is now under Alert Level 3. Phivolcs posted a timelapse video of the volcano’s eruption on its Facebook page. Alert Level 3, according to Phivolcs, means there is a\"high level of volcanic unrest.\" Get the latest news delivered to your inbox Sign up for The Manila Times newsletters By signing up with an email address, I acknowledge that I have read and agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. \"Sustained increases in the levels of volcanic earthquakes, some may be perceptible. Occurrence of low-frequency earthquakes, volcanic tremor, rumbling sounds,\" Phivolcs said on its website.\"Forceful and voluminous steam\/ash ejections. Sustained increases in sulfur dioxide emission rates, ground deformation\/swelling of the edifice. Activity at the summit may involve dome growth and\/or lava flow, resultant rockfall,\" it added, Advertisement
